The domestic content bonus credit premium, relative to the base credit, is lower under the Section 45 production tax credit than the Section 48 ITC. However, project owners may still receive more total credits under Section 45, depending on the number of bonus credits taken, the cost of the project, and the amount of electricity the project generates.
